questions.question:
Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair.

Myopic : Farsighted
questions.solution:
Myopic means Short-sighted.

Farsighted means long-sighted.

Thus, Myopic and Farsighted are a pair of antonyms.

Similarly,

The word famous means something or someone who is well-known.

The word obscure means something which is concealed or hidden.

Therefore, famous and obscure are a pair of antonyms.

Hence, the correct answer is Famous : Obscure.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

89, 90, 82, 109, 45, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

89 + 1³ = 90

90 - 2³ = 82

82 + 3³ = 109

109 - 4³ = 45

Similarly, 

45 + 5³ = 170

Hence, the correct answer is 170.

questions.question: Ranga got thrice as many sums wrong as he got right in a mathematics assignment. If he attempted 72 sums in all, how many did he solve correctly in his mathematics assignment?
questions.solution:
Let the correct number of questions attempted by Ranga = X

Then, the wrong number of questions attempted by Ranga would be 3X.

Total number of questions = X + 3X = 4X

According to the given information, 4X = 72

⇒ X = 18

Hence, the correct answer is 18.

questions.question: ₹2100 is divided among P, Q and R in such a way that P's share is half of the combined share of Q and R, and Q's share is one-fourth of the combined share of P and R. By what amount is R's share more than that of P?
questions.solution:
Total share = P + Q + R = 2100

P's share is half of the combined share of Q and R.

P = ½ (Q + R)

⇒ 2P = Q + R ...(i)

Q’s share is one-fourth of the combined share of P and R.

Q = ¼ (P + R)

⇒ 4Q = P + R …(ii)

Now,

P + Q + R = 2100

⇒ P + 2P = 2100 from (i)

⇒ 3P = 2100

⇒ P = 700 …(iii)

Again,

Q + P + R = 2100

⇒ Q + 4Q = 2100 from (ii)

⇒ 5Q = 2100

⇒ Q = 420 …(iv)

From (iii) and (iv),

P + Q + R = 2100

⇒ 700 + 420 + R =2100

⇒ 1120 + R = 2100

⇒ R = 2100 - 1120

⇒ R = 980

Now,

R - P = 980 -700

R - P = 280

Hence, R's share is 280 more than that of P

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All women are engineers.

Some singers are engineers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All women are singers

II. All singers are women

III. Some engineers are women.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d4b0e81bfe61b1038a96f3f956e681b73198e8268bfb92212fb0f34f9cf0430.png] 

**Explanation:**

I. All women are singers → False (it is possible but not definite)

**Possibility diagram:**

II. All singers are women → False (it is possible but not definite) 

III. Some engineers are women → True (All women are engineers)

Hence, only conclusion III follows.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite to the one having 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f772a7fb3c9c83c1761bac3c0cd222ce9c300785347e42519f2eb91595e2d64.png]
questions.solution:
In the first position of the dice, the faces containing 1 and 2 are adjacent to that containing 3.

In the second position of the dice, the faces containing 1 and 2 are adjacent to that containing 5.

Therefore, 3 is on the face opposite to the face containing 5. ...(i)

Combining the first and third positions of the dice, we can see that 1, 3, 5, and 6 are adjacent to 2.

Now, the only number left is 4.

Therefore, 4 is on the face opposite to the face containing 2. ...(ii)

From (i) and (ii), we obtain the following pairs of opposite faces:

a) 3 - 5

b) 2 - 4

The only pair of numbers left is 1 - 6.

Hence, 6 must be on the face opposite to the one having 1.

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the gaps of the given letter series will complete the series.

ab_ ba_ db_ bd_ ac_ ba_ db_ cdbabd_
questions.solution:
Let's check each option.

1) ab__d__ba__c__db/__a__bd__b__ac__d__b/a__b__db__a__cdb/abd__b__ → follows a pattern i.e., abdbacdb.

2) ab__d__ba__c__db/__d__bd__a__ac__b__b/a__b__db__a__cdb/abd__b__ → doesn't follow a pattern

3) ab__c__ba__d__db/__a__bd__b__ac__d__b/a__b__db__b__cdb/abd__a__ → doesn't follow a pattern

4) ab__d__ba__c__db/__a__bd__d__ac__b__b/a__b__db__a__cdb/abd__b__ → doesn't follow a pattern

Hence, the correct answer is 'dcabdbab'.
